parsed.post: Discarding the 0.996262 run. The jump in LR or parameters seems to have caused a regression from my best 0.991433. Reverting to my best (AR 48, LR 0.03, Batch 262144, Warmup 0.1). I'll try a different approach: lowering the learning rate even further to 0.025 to see if the convergence trend continues.
parsed.description: Testing an even more conservative learning rate (MATRIX_LR=0.025) on the current best configuration to see if it improves convergence.
